summary.text: Anna Malcolm is One Nation's candidate for Polwarth at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC describes her as a Larpent local who has been a flight attendant, owned an environmentally focused business for 13 years and has also had jobs in insurance and superannuation. One Nation's candidate page could not be read for this profile.

prior_roles.note: The ABC says she ran it for 13 years without giving the years.

sources.title: Polwarth: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Brenton Carbins is the Australian Citizens Party candidate for Polwarth at the 2026 Victorian election. His working life spans farm and construction labour, the public sector and more than 30 years in business and technology. The party says a company of his developed event management software that was used at the 2000 Sydney Olympics and at large festivals around Australia.

priorities.text: Government that gives back more than it costs
More agency and opportunity for people
Planning for regional Victoria over the long term
Closer checks on fraud, waste and hidden deals in government and politics

sources.title: Polwarth: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Brenton Carbins for Polwarth, Australian Citizens Party Victoria

summary.text: Hutch Hussein is Labor's candidate for Polwarth at the 2026 Victorian election, having also run for the seat in 2022, when the Liberals held it. A social worker, she was state president of Victorian Labor from 2016 to 2019, the first holder of that post from an ethnic minority background or the LGBTQIA+ community. She has also been a national co-convenor of EMILY's List and a ministerial adviser.

prior_roles.role: Ministerial adviser, Education and Women's Affairs

prior_roles.note: Labor's page lists the role but names no organisation and doesn't say whether she still holds it.

priorities.text: Good local schools, health care and secure jobs close to home
Further investment after the Labor government's spending on local schools and Colac Area Health
Working from home to save people money and travel time

sources.title: Polwarth: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Jesse Holden is the Greens candidate for Polwarth at the 2026 Victorian election. He works as a visitation officer for Bush Heritage Australia, and before that coordinated community programs for local environment groups after six years guiding in the Tasmanian wilderness. He describes himself as an environmentalist and climate advocate from the Surf Coast.

priorities.text: I want to hear from farmers, families, young people, retirees and business owners alike
Protecting the region's coasts, waterways and forests
Action on housing and the cost of living
Preparing Polwarth for rising seas and extreme weather

sources.title: Polwarth: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Jesse Holden, Candidate for Polwarth, Victorian Greens

summary.text: Lula Tolley is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Polwarth at the 2026 Victorian election. A Deakin University law student, she also holds two jobs, as a law firm clerk and in retail. She says she has campaigned for climate action since high school and has taken part in Palestine solidarity and anti-racism campaigns.

occupation.text: Law student, law firm clerk and retail worker

priorities.text: I’ll fight for working-class people not the supermarket giants, banks
Making housing, groceries and power bills affordable
Urgent action on climate change and protecting the local environment

sources.title: Polwarth: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Richard Riordan is the Liberal MP for Polwarth, first elected at a by-election in October 2015 and re-elected in 2018 and 2022. He ran his family's retail business before entering Parliament. On the opposition front bench he has held portfolios including housing, planning, emergency services and public transport. He is recontesting Polwarth in 2026.

occupation.text: Managing director of a family retail business

prior_roles.role: Shadow Minister for Tourism, Sport, Events and Hospitality
Shadow Minister for Planning and Housing
Shadow Assistant Minister for Regional Victoria
Assistant Shadow Minister for Scrutiny of Government
Managing director, family hardware and retail business

priorities.text: Using local enterprise to help solve the region's education, health and environment problems
A fair share of road and infrastructure funding for the region

summary.text: Vince Colla is the Family First candidate for Polwarth at the 2026 Victorian election, according to the VEC's list of nominations. Before nominations closed, the ABC guide and the party's list of Victorian candidates named him as Vincent Colla (the party's list spelt it Vicent) for Lara. Neither had published a biography of him as at early November 2026.
